script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: small-town life

Begin screenplay.

Title: Small Town Secrets

INT. SMALL TOWN CAFÉ - DAY

A quaint, rustic café nestled in the heart of MIDDLEBURGH, a picturesque small town. The sun pours in through the windows, warming the room.

JANE (30s), a vibrant local woman, sits at a table, scribbling in a notepad. She looks up as the CAFE OWNER, MRS. MCCORMICK (60s), enters, carrying a fresh pot of coffee.

MRS. MCCORMICK
(cheerfully)
Another scribe's morning, I see.

JANE
(smiling)
Yes, Mrs. McCormick. I've got a story brewing.

MRS. MCCORMICK
Well, let it simmer here with us. You know our little town has a knack for providing some interesting characters.

INT. JANE'S HOUSE - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Jane sits on her couch, her laptop open in front of her. She's lost in thought, a cup of tea nearby.

Suddenly, her doorbell rings. It's BOB, the town postman, who's also the amateur town detective.

BOB (50s)
(excited)
Jane! I've cracked it!

JANE
(confused)
What have you cracked, Bob?

BOB
(grinning)
The mystery of the lost garden gnomes!

INT. TOWN HALL - DAY

Bob and Jane meet with the TOWN MAYOR, MRS. BAKER (70s), and other townsfolk to discuss the latest town mystery.

MRS. BAKER
(frustrated)
Another bunch of gnomes have gone missing! What's going on, Bob?

BOB
(determined)
I believe it's connected to the missing town funds. I just need to gather more evidence.

INT. LIBRARY - DAY

Bob and Jane are poring over dusty town records when they stumble upon an old diary.

BOB
(surprised)
Jane, this might be our breakthrough!

INT. JANE'S HOUSE - NIGHT

Jane and Bob pore over the diary late into the night, piecing together clues about the missing gnomes and funds.

INT. SMALL TOWN CAFÉ - DAY

The pair share their findings with the townsfolk at the café. Laughter and excitement fill the room as the mystery unravels.

MRS. MCCORMICK
(amused)
Well, well, Middleburgh's little detectives have done it again.

EXT. TOWN SQUARE - NIGHT

The townsfolk gather to celebrate the resolution of the mystery, with a garden gnome parade through the town.

JANE
(smiling)
It's moments like these that make small-town life so special.

INT. SMALL TOWN CAFÉ - MORNING

Jane sits at her usual table, sipping coffee and jotting down her latest findings. Bob enters with a stack of mail.

BOB
(laughing)
You'll never believe the latest town mystery...

The screen fades to black as Jane looks up, eager to hear what Bob has to say.

THE END.
